styles.notes: Reviewed contact sheet: hand-drawn/animatic narrative with muted greens/browns, strong black outlines, emotional close-ups and silhouette reveals. Not a recovered brush history.
mechanics: Group values before detail; keep face readable in close-up.
Use silhouette scale for threat/reveal beats.
Hold emotional poses between sketch cuts.

styles.notes: Reviewed contact sheet: dark sci-fi staged animation with green/orange emissive accents, glowing rims, depth parallax and diegetic UI. Title cards identify Indie Cross/Moro branding; technique study only.
mechanics: Separate emissive accents from dark base for focal hierarchy.
Stage impact poses with clear silhouette and glow spill.

styles.notes: Reviewed contact sheet: fast montage mixing anime shots, 3D jets/rooms and device/phone motifs. Composition relies on scale contrast, occlusion and rhythmic cutting rather than one continuous scene.
mechanics: Cut on shape/motion matches across mixed media.
Use foreground occluders and scale jumps for energy.
Protect a readable focal object during rapid cuts.

styles.notes: Reviewed contact sheet: stylized 2D Godzilla/Kong preview with painted fur/scales, dorsal silhouette, shoreline depth and white splash linework. Fan animation; study mechanics, not reuse characters.
mechanics: Establish scale with horizon and shoreline layers.
Anticipate heavy steps before splash/impact overlap.
Keep dorsal/fin silhouette readable against sky.

styles.notes: Reviewed contact sheet: portrait screen-recorded drawing tutorial constructing an anime character, flat cel passes and final rim/lighting polish. UI chrome is part of the recording.
mechanics: Construct large shapes before facial detail.
Separate flat color, shadow and rim-light passes.
Zoom to the active construction region while keeping context.

styles.notes: Reviewed candidate sheet: commentary/script visuals mixing talking heads, reaction images, anime/manga clips, screen recordings and sponsor cards. 242 low-motion insert candidates flagged; four visible brand/sponsor ranges excluded with source evidence. Remaining meme origins are not confirmed.
mechanics: Place reaction insert after the verbal setup.
Keep sponsor/brand cards separate from animation geometry.
Review low-motion inserts before excluding or attributing origin.

scope: Reviewed from local trace contact sheets/candidate frames. Tags are editorial observations, not a trained style model.
